name: @zhushanwen/z-subagent-workflow
description: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (default daemon thin client; the MCP tool face is offline since 1.0.0): background subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, conversation flag (record-state-only; follow-up resume unavailable) and model routing, plus core-unified agent .md discovery (vendored built-in roles + user roots, absolute-path agent refs shared with the pi platform) and built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) with custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path — including the script-generate/lint/save/delete creative loop. Completion wakeup rides engine-native task-notification (CLI blocking command + Bash run_in_background), no polling.
author: zhushanwen (https://github.com/zhushanwen321)
